{{Quote|Yes, Lord Vader. I've reached the main power generators. The shield will be down in moments. You may start your landing.|General Maximilian Veers to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], regarding the Echo Base shield generator|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Blizzard Force''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] unit, an elite formation within the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] specializing in cold-weather operations. It is most famous for serving as the core of the ground assault force that attacked [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], under the command of [[Major General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]. Because of their frequent use of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] walkers, their logo was adorned with an AT-AT.

==Operational history==
Blizzard Force were not part of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron's]] integrated surface-warfare forces, but were called on at General Veers' suggestion when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] headquarters was located on the frigid world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Not only were they the ideal troops to attack a snow-bound target, but they were well-positioned to assist, so that the fleet needed only to make a brief rendezvous to take aboard the extra troops before proceeding on to the target.

[[File:Blizzard_Force.jpg|left|thumb|[[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] and snowtroopers of the Blizzard Force]]

For the assault on Echo Base, the snowtroopers were combined with armored units already under Veers' command, foremost among them being the elite [[Thundering Herd/Legends|Thundering Herd]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] squadron. The final assault force consisted of least nine AT-ATs (led by ''[[Blizzard 1/Legends|Blizzard 1]]''), plus a number of [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]]s, [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] (led by ''[[Blizzard Scout 1]]''), [[All Terrain Advance Raider|AT-ARs]], and [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PTs]], a [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|snow scout]] patrol, plus the [[Snow Hawks|infantry]] of Blizzard Force itself.<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Some stormtroopers from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] also apparently participated in the battle, wearing snowtrooper armor: these may have been the troops who accompanied [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on his arrival at the base.

[[File:BlizzardLogo.jpg|right|thumb|Blizzard Force logo]]

Blizzard Force, under General Veers' direction from the lead walker, ''Blizzard 1'', succeeded in capturing Echo Base, despite the loss of a number of walkers to the terrain and to enemy action. Although the heavy armor of the AT-ATs made them virtually immune to laser fire, three vehicles of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Starck/Legends|Starck's]] group were lost to ice crevasses in the [[Kerane Valley/Legends|Kerane Valley]], while [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], led by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], attacked in [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]], using their magnetic harpoons and tow cables to entangle the walkers' feet and thus topple them. Four Imperial walkers, including ''[[Blizzard 2/Legends|Blizzard 2]]'' were destroyed by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Antilles']] strafing attack while thus immobilized,<ref name="RS II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> and the undamaged ''[[Blizzard 4/Legends|Blizzard 4]]'' and another AT-AT were destroyed by Skywalker's [[V-59 concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]] from the ground.<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] eventually succeeded in breaching the cockpit armor of ''Blizzard 1'', severely injuring Veers himself.

By this point, however, the Rebels' shield generator had been destroyed, and their defensive perimeter had been broken. Additional troops led by Lord Vader in person deployed from the orbiting Star Destroyers, and the snowtroopers entered the ice-hewn tunnels of Echo Base.

[[File:BlizzardForce.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A portion of Blizzard Force during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]]]

The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] marked a decisive victory for the Empire, driving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in headlong retreat from their command base and going some way to avenge the defeat at [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin]]. The contribution of the 501st Legion to the battle was called their finest hour. However, while all Imperial objectives were achieved, and in numerical terms, the loss of a relative handful of troops in the battle was entirely acceptable, one of the Empire's elite assault units had sustained heavy casualties against inferior and improvised defenses. General Veers was left badly injured and the ice-plains of Hoth were strewn with the wreckage of downed AT-ATs.
